label: Hertz contact (CONTESTED)
text: EN.O.A1.4.1 Hertz contact. For two smooth, elastic, non-conforming bodies with frictionless contact and small contact area: contact radius and peak pressure follow from load, curvatures and moduli. CONTESTED: PH.O.A1.5 is the alternative owner.
